about.title: About
about.description: About Naomi Shore: a software engineer who joined PebblePad as an apprentice in 2019 and earned a first-class degree alongside the job.
about.heading: About me
about.lead: I'm Naomi, a software engineer from Telford with seven years at PebblePad and a real soft spot for accessibility.
about.apprenticeship: I joined PebblePad as an apprentice in 2019 and earned a first-class BSc through a degree apprenticeship, studying and shipping production code in the same week. It taught me to pick up new domains quickly and to explain my thinking clearly.
about.nowadays: Today I'm a Software Engineer II working across the full stack, from C#/.NET distributed back ends to React and TypeScript front ends. Most of my recent work has been in a dedicated accessibility team: fixing WCAG 2.2 issues, building captions and transcription, and testing with real assistive technology.
about.aiAdoption: I was also an early adopter of AI-assisted and agentic development in my team. Used thoughtfully, it's helped make us one of the most productive teams in the company.
about.accessibleByDefaultDescription: Keyboard, screen reader, zoom and contrast checks are part of done, not a later ticket.
about.smallChangesDescription: Short pull requests, clear commit messages and tests that explain intent.
about.testWithTheRealThingDescription: Real assistive technology and real users beat any automated checker on its own.
about.writeItDownDescription: Decision records and READMEs, so the next person (often me) has the context.

privacy.description: What this site collects about you, and why.
privacy.intro: This site collects as little as possible. Here's exactly what, and why.
privacy.email: I use your name, email address and message only to reply to you. They're never shared, sold or added to a mailing list, and I delete old conversations after 12 months.
privacy.cookies: No tracking cookies and no analytics. Your light or dark mode choice is saved in your browser so it's remembered next time.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see or delete anything you've sent me. Email <email>{{email}}</email> and I'll sort it within a month.
